title: Fleet board row
description: One row the console's live fleet-board surface serves — an issue from .board/snapshot.json joined with its latest .board/claims.jsonl claim state (issue #880, EPIC #878 lane L1). Validated by portal.server.livestore.load_board_rows before it ever reaches an HTTP response: a row that fails this schema is refused by name, never served best-effort.

number.description: The GitHub issue number this row projects (.board/snapshot.json issues[].number).

lane.description: The lane claiming the issue, from the most recent unreleased claim event in .board/claims.jsonl; empty string when no lane currently holds it.

claimed_by.description: The agent id holding the most recent unreleased claim; empty string when unclaimed.

claimed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the claim event; empty string when unclaimed.
